<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has checked Elena's and David's calendars and has found that none of the times I proposed work for them. He has sent me a list of available slots for Elena and David. I need to check these new proposed times against Priya's and Marcus's calendars.

Here are the free times Brad proposed:
- Mon: 11:00, 11:30
- Tue: 09:00, 09:30
- Wed: 13:00, 13:30
- Thu: 09:30, 15:00
- Fri: 14:30, 15:00, 15:30

Now, I'll check these times against the calendars of Priya and Marcus. I have the calendars from my previous session.

**Priya Raman's busy times:**
- Mon: 11:00-11:30 (Travel) -> So Mon 11:00 is not free. 11:30 is not busy.
- Tue: 09:00-09:30 (Board prep), 09:30-10:00 (Partner lunch) -> So Tue 09:00 and 09:30 are not free.
- Wed: 13:00-13:30 (Client call - Harbor Logistics), 13:30-14:00 (Client dinner prep) -> So Wed 13:00 and 13:30 are not free.
- Thu: 09:30-10:00 (Busy) -> So Thu 09:30 is not free. 15:00 is not busy.
- Fri: 14:30-15:00 (Client call - Harbor Logistics), 15:00-15:30 (Hiring panel), 15:30-16:00 (Contract review - Weller Group) -> So Fri 14:30, 15:00, and 15:30 are not free.

**Marcus Hale's busy times:**
- Mon: 11:30-12:00 (Busy) -> So Mon 11:30 is not free. 11:00 is not busy.
- Tue: 09:00-09:30 (Recruiting call), 09:30-10:00 (Litigation strategy) -> So Tue 09:00 and 09:30 are not free.
- Wed: 13:00-13:30 (Partner lunch), 13:30-14:00 (Litigation strategy) -> So Wed 13:00 and 13:30 are not free.
- Thu: 09:30-10:00 (Contract review - Weller Group) -> So Thu 09:30 is not free. 15:00 is not busy.
- Fri: 14:30-15:00 (nothing listed), 15:00-15:30 (Travel), 15:30-16:00 (Busy) -> So Fri 15:00 and 15:30 are not free. 14:30 is not busy.

Let's cross-reference and find a common slot:
- Mon 11:00: Priya is busy. Marcus is free. No.
- Mon 11:30: Priya is free. Marcus is busy. No.
- Tue 09:00: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.
- Tue 09:30: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.
- Wed 13:00: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.
- Wed 13:30: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.
- Thu 09:30: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.
- **Thu 15:00:** Priya is free. Marcus is free. **Yes!**
- Fri 14:30: Priya is busy. Marcus is free. No.
- Fri 15:00: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.
- Fri 15:30: Priya is busy. Marcus is busy. No.

It seems the only time that works for all four partners is Thursday at 15:00.

I will now book this time and inform Brad that I have booked it. Brad is responsible for sending the confirmation email.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
